name: Level
fix_description: In claimMultiple, users[epoch][msg.sender].claimed is set to the claimable amount (the delta) rather than the cumulative vested amount. This means on subsequent claims during vesting, the claimed value is reset to a lower value, allowing repeated claims of the same rewards. Fix: use claimed += reward (accumulate) or set claimed to the total vested amount, not the incremental claimable.
difficulty_reasoning: The root bug is simple—claiming multiple times by passing duplicate epoch IDs to claimMultiple—but the PoC requires several protocol-specific setup steps: creating a referral tree, generating referral/trading points via repeated wash trades with a flash loan, advancing epochs with privileged timing on a fork, then exploiting duplicate-array claims repeatedly. An experienced auditor could reproduce it within 30 minutes to 2 hours after understanding the referral reward mechanics, but it is more than a trivial single-call exploit.
